assertions.subject: Felon
assertions.quote: A felon is an infection of the pulp space of the fingertip, usually with staphylococci and streptococci.

assertions.subject: Palm Abscess
assertions.predicate: purulent infection of deep spaces in the palm
assertions.quote: A palm abscess is a purulent infection of deep spaces in the palm, typically with staphylococci or streptococci.

assertions.subject: Infectious Flexor Tenosynovitis
assertions.predicate: acute infection within the flexor tendon sheath
assertions.quote: Infectious flexor tenosynovitis is an acute infection within the flexor tendon sheath.

assertions.subject: Infectious Flexor Tenosynovitis
assertions.quote: Acute calcific tendinitis and RA can restrict motion and cause pain in the tendon sheath but can usually be differentiated from infectious flexor tenosynovitis by a more gradual onset and the absence of some of Kanavel's signs.
